description: This file defines the RelationService interface for managing entity relations within the Thingsboard platform, including methods for creating, deleting, and querying relations.

classes.name: RelationService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for managing entity relations, including creation, deletion, and querying of relations.

methods.name: checkRelationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if a relation exists between two entities.

methods.name: checkRelation
methods.description: Checks if a relation exists between two entities.

methods.name: getRelation
methods.description: Retrieves a specific relation between two entities.

methods.name: saveRelation
methods.description: Saves a relation between entities.

methods.name: saveRelations
methods.description: Saves multiple relations.

methods.name: saveRelationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously saves a relation.

methods.name: deleteRelation
methods.description: Deletes a specific relation.

methods.name: deleteRelationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a specific relation.

methods.name: deleteRelation
methods.description: Deletes a relation based on from/to entities and relation type.

methods.name: deleteRelationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a relation based on from/to entities and relation type.

methods.name: deleteEntityRelations
methods.description: Deletes all relations associated with an entity.

methods.name: deleteEntityCommonRelations
methods.description: Deletes common relations associated with an entity.

methods.name: findByFrom
methods.description: Finds relations originating from a specific entity.

methods.name: findByFromAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds relations originating from a specific entity.

methods.name: findInfoByFrom
methods.description: Finds relation info originating from a specific entity.

methods.name: findByFromAndType
methods.description: Finds relations from a specific entity of a certain type.

methods.name: findByFromAndTypeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds relations from a specific entity of a certain type.

methods.name: findByTo
methods.description: Finds relations pointing to a specific entity.

methods.name: findByToAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds relations pointing to a specific entity.

methods.name: findInfoByTo
methods.description: Finds relation info pointing to a specific entity.

methods.name: findByToAndType
methods.description: Finds relations to a specific entity of a certain type.

methods.name: findByToAndTypeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds relations to a specific entity of a certain type.

methods.name: findByQuery
methods.description: Finds relations based on a query.

methods.name: findInfoByQuery
methods.description: Finds relation info based on a query.

methods.name: removeRelations
methods.description: Removes all relations for a given entity.

methods.name: findRuleNodeToRuleChainRelations
methods.description: Finds relations between rule nodes and rule chains.

methods.name: findByRelationPathQueryAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds relations based on a relation path query.

methods.name: findFilteredRelationsByPathQueryAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds relations based on a relation path query with filtering.

methods.name: findByRelationPathQuery
methods.description: Finds relations based on a relation path query.
